figurative_meaning_en: the taste lingering on the tongue
example_sentences_in_bangla: সেই মিষ্টির স্বাদ এখনও মুখে লেগে আছে।
এই গানের সুর মুখে লেগে থাকবে অনেকদিন।
example_sentences_in_english: The taste of that sweet is still lingering in my mouth.
The tune of this song will linger in my mind for days.
note: This idiom often metaphorically refers to a pleasant or memorable experience that persists.
